family.description: This entry represents a domain of unknown function in putative TLC domain-containing and other uncharacterised proteins mostly found in fungi. These proteins contain a SNARE-like fold. They are characterised by their tetrameric coiled-coil structures that facilitate membrane fusion processes. SNARE proteins are present in synaptic terminals, endoplasmic reticulum, and Golgi apparatus where the coiled-coil structure is important for membrane targeting and fusion specificity. The conserved coiled-coil architecture enables these proteins to function in vesicle trafficking and membrane fusion events [[cite:PUB00161918]].
family.name: Domain of unknown function (DUF8335)
